title: Visualizer Studies
description: Five independent square studies exploring different lyric-visualizer moods, density levels, and non-readable text rhythms.
creative_direction: These independent studies should each read like a frozen frame from a music lyric visualizer: pseudo-typographic rhythm, cinematic atmosphere, and motion implication without actual words or software interfaces.
